text: GALND[mu,n,nb] denotes the negative component in the lightcone decomposition of the Dirac matrix \gamma^{\mu } along the vectors n and nb in D-dimensions. It corresponds to \frac{1}{2} n^{\mu} (\gamma \cdot \bar{n}).
Overview, DiracGamma, GALPD, GALRD, GSLPD, GSLND, GSLRD.
